notes: Written from scratch for this project. Periods: latest_fy / prior_fy = the fiscal years of the two most recent 10-Ks; latest_fy_end = balance-sheet date of the latest 10-K; latest_release = quarter covered by the latest earnings 8-K; latest_proxy = fiscal year covered by the latest DEF 14A; current = most recent disclosure in any filing. 'grade' says how the eval scores an item: numeric (tolerance vs. golden), judged (LLM judge vs. golden text), or support_only (judgment calls: only citation support is scored).
